description:
Pull DataForSEO Labs domain_intersection for (site_domain, competitor_domain): the Google keywords the competitor ranks for that the site doesn't, plus those where it outranks the site. The classic-SEO sibling of mine_competitor_prompts (the AI citation gap).

Billing: 25¢ per run. The same site, competitor, location, language and limit within 24h is served from cache free (charged_cents=0). Not billed when the site_id or competitor_domain is rejected, or when no keywords come back (charged_cents=0).

When to call: 'what does <competitor> rank for that we don't', 'Google content gap vs <competitor>'.

Returns: { rows: [{keyword, search_volume, cpc_cents, competition, kd, intent, competitor_position, user_position, competitor_url, user_url, gap_kind: 'they_rank_we_dont'|'they_outrank_us'|'co_ranked', relevance, opportunity}], dropped: {competitor_brand_queries, competitor_below_position}, max_competitor_position, position_basis, user_domain, competitor_domain, location_code, language_code, generated_at, cache_hit, charged_cents }. Positions are organic places (position_basis 'organic', rank_group: the AI Overview and other SERP features aren't counted), as Search Console counts them.
Ranking: real gaps first, then opportunity = search_volume × the competitor's position weight (#1 = 1, #10 ≈ 0.25) × relevance (0–1: share of the keyword's words the site's tracked questions and keywords use; null without any). Dropped by default: the competitor's brand searches ("<brand>", "<brand> pricing", misspellings navigational to its homepage; "<brand> alternative" / "vs" stay) and keywords it ranks below max_competitor_position for. kd: organic difficulty 0–100; competition: Google Ads advertiser competition 0–1 (paid, not organic); cpc_cents: Ads cost per click.

competitor_domain must be on the site's competitor list (list_sites); a rejected one returns competitor_not_on_site with valid_competitor_domains.

Example: { site_id: "...", competitor_domain: "asana.com" }

competitor_domain.description: Must be on the site's competitor_domains list (see list_sites).

include_brand_queries.description: true: keep the competitor's own brand searches. Default false.

language_code.description: Default: the location's language (en for US/UK/CA/AU, de for DE, fr for FR…).

limit.description: Max keywords per intersection mode, 10–100. Default 100.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (US). 2826 UK, 2124 CA, 2036 AU, 2276 DE, 2250 FR.

max_competitor_position.description: Only keywords the competitor ranks in the top N for. Default 20.

name: find_content_gap
title: Find Google-search keywords a competitor ranks for that this site doesn't
